vocabulary.definition: a state of matter similar to gas in which a certain portion of the particles are ionized
vocabulary.example: The Sun's plasma is pushed around and shaped by its magnetic field.

vocabulary.definition: a machine for converting mechanical energy into electrical energy
vocabulary.example: The dynamo within the Sun keeps its magnetic field alive.

vocabulary.definition: natural light displays in the sky caused by the collision of energetic charged particles with atoms in the high-altitude atmosphere
vocabulary.example: During geomagnetic storms, auroras can be seen at the North and South Poles.

vocabulary.definition: to bring about or give rise to
vocabulary.example: A strong solar storm can induce currents in our power grid.

vocabulary.definition: involving or causing sudden great damage or suffering
vocabulary.example: If an unprepared super flare hits Earth, the consequences can be catastrophic.

vocabulary.definition: to start up or restart a computer or system
vocabulary.example: After a power outage, it might be extremely hard to reboot our broken power grid.
